block.guhs.droombrievenbus_wolkje.lore: Stands on the Dream Square. Click it in a dream: Dream Post takes you to your own dream cloud. Sneak-click: how to let friends build along.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.nog_niet: Your dream cloud isn't ready yet... help Snoes fall asleep first, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.geen_wolkje: They have no dream cloud yet. Not dreamed vads enough!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bezoeker: You're visiting. Looking is fine, building isn't. Wipe your paws!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.niet_van_jou: Not yours, vadsje! When visiting you only look.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bus.uitleg: Your dream cloud is yours: build whatever you like! Let friends build along: /droomwolkje vriend <name> (remove: /droomwolkje weg <name>, the list: /droomwolkje vrienden). Visit someone: /droomwolkje bezoek <name>. Back to the square: the jetty with the big bubble.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.erbij: %s may now build along on your dream cloud. Vads together!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.weg: %s no longer builds along on your dream cloud.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.melding: %1$s invited you to build along on their dream cloud! (/droomwolkje bezoek %1$s)
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.zelf: Yourself? You may already do anything on your own cloud, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vrienden.geen: Nobody builds along on your dream cloud yet.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vrienden.lijst: Building along on your dream cloud: %s
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bezoek.droom: Visiting happens in a dream. Have a good sleep first!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.knuffel.jij: You gave %s a hug. Now it dreams even sweeter!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.knabbel.jij: You gave %s a nibble. Munch munch, in its sleep!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.bericht.knuffe: %s gave %s a hug in Guh Dreamland 💤
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.bericht.knabbe: %s gave %s a nibble in Guh Dreamland 💤
